test.query: SELECT timeSeriesTagsToGroup( [], concat('tag', toString(number % 128)), CAST(if(number % 8 = 0, NULL, concat('value', toString(number % 256))), 'Nullable(String)')) FROM numbers(5000000) SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_block_size = 500000 FORMAT Null

SELECT timeSeriesTagsToGroup( [], concat('tag0', toString(number % 128)), CAST(if(number % 8 = 0, NULL, concat('value0', toString(number % 256))), 'Nullable(String)'), concat('tag1', toString(number % 128)), CAST(if(number % 8 = 0, NULL, concat('value1', toString(number % 256))), 'Nullable(String)'), concat('tag2', toString(number % 128)), CAST(if(number % 8 = 0, NULL, concat('value2', toString(number % 256))), 'Nullable(String)'), concat('tag3', toString(number % 128)), CAST(if(number % 8 = 0, NULL, concat('value3', toString(number % 256))), 'Nullable(String)')) FROM numbers(5000000) SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_block_size = 500000 FORMAT Null

SELECT timeSeriesTagsToGroup( [], toFixedString(concat('k', toString(number % 1000)), 4), CAST(if(number % 8 = 0, NULL, toFixedString(concat('v', toString(number % 1000)), 4)), 'Nullable(FixedString(4))')) FROM numbers(5000000) SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_block_size = 500000 FORMAT Null

SELECT timeSeriesTagsToGroup( [], toFixedString(concat('k0', toString(number % 100)), 8), CAST(if(number % 8 = 0, NULL, toFixedString(concat('v0', toString(number % 100)), 8)), 'Nullable(FixedString(8))'), toFixedString(concat('k1', toString(number % 100)), 8), CAST(if(number % 8 = 0, NULL, toFixedString(concat('v1', toString(number % 100)), 8)), 'Nullable(FixedString(8))'), toFixedString(concat('k2', toString(number % 100)), 8), CAST(if(number % 8 = 0, NULL, toFixedString(concat('v2', toString(number % 100)), 8)), 'Nullable(FixedString(8))'), toFixedString(concat('k3', toString(number % 100)), 8), CAST(if(number % 8 = 0, NULL, toFixedString(concat('v3', toString(number % 100)), 8)), 'Nullable(FixedString(8))')) FROM numbers(5000000) SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_block_size = 500000 FORMAT Null
